queue_type: SQLite async_delegations table plus process-local completion_queue
foreign_key_or_session_relationship: logical parent/origin session fields; no SQL foreign key that establishes AOTA ownership
requires_child_run_record: native lifecycle implies one; AOTA task is not native child run
requires_live_owner: true for safe target ownership; restart restore still requires positive proof
queue_watcher_auto_claim: true only for correctly formed native event in the current profile/process
native_queue_adapter_risk: HIGH; row insertion alone would bypass native dispatch identity, child ownership, profile scope and route validation
upgrade_compatibility: poor; async_delegations schema is internal and may evolve
recommendation: do not write AOTA completions directly into async_delegations; use AOTA outbox as source and a trusted backend adapter
